scene: You ride the rumbling mail train as brass pneumatic tubes hiss overhead.
beats: The parcel hums a gentle lullaby, tinting your grey beard bright blue. The train squeals to a halt at Lost Property Depot, and the doors slide open.
The badger conductor happily slips you a shiny golden parcel token for your trouble. Right on cue, the brakes hiss and the doors open at Lost Property Depot.
Violet dust puffs out, revealing a chirping clockwork sparrow inside. With a gentle jolt, the train arrives at Lost Property Depot, its doors sliding wide.
picture: Inside the train, from left to right along the level carriage floor: a glowing parcel sits beside a post sack, the player in corduroy jacket and prosthetic leg leans on a bench, a badger conductor sorts envelopes at a cubby, and a brass wall chute with a lever stands near the exit.
shown: a softly glowing, stamped parcel sitting on the floor at the far left
a badger conductor wearing brass spectacles sorting letters in the centre
a polished brass mail chute hatch sealed with a red lever on the right

after.label: Step off at Lost Property Depot
Stay on
after.beat: You stay put as the depot slips past. A rogue stamp flutters by before you swap to the bridge crawler, rumbling straight toward the bustling stalls of giant Gear Bridge.
